title: General rule of construction
text: 4. Subject to the provisions of the Interpretation of Laws Act and the expressions specifically defined in this Code, the Code shall be construed according to the principles of construction which may be applied to any written law, with regard to Tanzanian conditions and without applying any principle of strict construction relating to penal legislation.

explanation.summary: Kifungu hiki kinaweka kanuni ya jumla ya namna Penal Code inavyopaswa kutafsiriwa.
points: Maandishi ya Penal Code yanapaswa kusomwa kwa kufuata kanuni ya tafsiri iliyowekwa na kifungu hiki.
Official text ndiyo yenye mamlaka; ufafanuzi huu ni msaada wa kuelewa muundo wa kifungu.

terms.meaning: Namna masharti ya sheria yanavyotafsiriwa na kusomwa.
